item.title: Show HN: I put employees inside S&P 500 market-cap bubbles
item.description:
📝 Inside it, one stick figure stands for employees, so a bubble crowded with small figures is worth little per worker and a big bubble with a handful of figures is worth a lot. Every figure is the same size, so how densely a bubble is filled shows its employees per dollar of market cap. Only companies with at least employees and a market cap of at least are shown ( of the S&P 500), plus a few big companies with fewer employees, such as Palantir and Welltower, drawn as one half-size figure.
🔗 Read more: https://bigwhalehunting.com/workforce/
